user.title: Set up Jackery P1
user.description: Choose local LAN (HTTP) or Bluetooth. LAN requires Wi-Fi setup in the Jackery app; Bluetooth requires an account or an existing key.

manual.title: Enter Bluetooth key
manual.description: Use the Base64 key for your Jackery P1.

account.title: Sign in to Jackery
account.description: Your account credentials are used once to retrieve your P1 Bluetooth key. Only the Bluetooth key is saved in Home Assistant.

lan.title: Connect over LAN
lan.description: Enter the P1's local IP address or hostname. The meter must already be connected to Wi-Fi.

reconfigure.title: Change P1 connection mode
reconfigure.description: Changing the connection retains the Home Assistant config entry and entity IDs. Ensure you connect to the same physical meter.

error.cannot_authenticate: Could not sign in to Jackery. Check credentials, region, and network access.
error.cannot_get_devices: Could not retrieve the Jackery device list.
error.no_p1_devices: No bound Jackery P1 with a Bluetooth key was found.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the P1 over local HTTP.
error.invalid_host: Enter a valid HTTP hostname or IP address.
error.not_p1: The HTTP endpoint did not identify as a Jackery P1.
error.different_device: The LAN device serial does not match this entry.
